Linh Nguyen: Heads-up from the nightly link scan: found a 404 on the runtime kv-cache doc for the \"prefix caching\" anchor — slacking the URL: https://internal.redwood/runtime/kv-cache#prefix-caching
Maria Chen: Hmm ok. That area is under runtime docs. @Olga Petrov usually owns these pages?
Olga Petrov: Yep I shepherd runtime docs. I can take a look but need the failing probe output if anyone has it.
Linh Nguyen: Scan snippet: `GET /runtime/kv-cache#prefix-caching -> 404` and the source header is `## Prefix Caching ` (notice a trailing space from a copy-edit). Looks like the generator made a slug with an extra dash?
AJ: Trailing spaces can change the slug generation in our markdown pipeline. Quick fixes: trim the header in source, or add an explicit `{#prefix-caching}` id, or update the link to the generated slug. Smallest change is adding the explicit anchor.
Olga Petrov: I'll do the explicit anchor + add a short frontmatter changelog entry. If someone can quick-CR I'll merge today.
Sam Ortiz: Can review. Ping me when PR is up, I'll try to get it done within the hour.
Linh Nguyen: Also please add that exact URL to a smoke test so the scanner catches it earlier next time.
Maria Chen: Good call. @docs-bot can you create a ticket to add that URL to docs smoke tests and tag docs-platform + runtime docs?
docs-bot: Created DOCS-4399: \"Add runtime kv-cache anchor to docs smoke test (record failing URL)\" - https://issues.redwood/DOCS-4399 (assigned to docs-platform)
Olga Petrov: PR opened: https://git.redwood/runtime-docs/pull/4321  includes `{#prefix-caching}` on the header, a frontmatter changelog line, and a TODO to add the URL to the smoke test.
Sam Ortiz: Reviewing now. Left one tiny formatting suggestion. :mag_right:
Sam Ortiz: LGTM after CI passes.
Olga Petrov: CI is green, merged to main and deployed to staging. Verified the link is resolving. Closing the loop.
Linh Nguyen: Thanks all  really appreciate the quick turnaround\"
